en.title: Equation (24) has a negative literal value
en.problem_md:
Set the layer weight to zero and bias to one, so both features are $t_i=\operatorname{ReLU}(1)=1$, with balanced labels. After independent Gaussian noise, $\widehat T=1+\epsilon$ remains independent of Y and its true MI is zero. The zero-MI calculation for the constant label kernel is verified for any probability feature law.

Every kernel is one. The global term is $-\log1=0$. Each class bracket is $-(1/2)\log(1/2)$, then weighted by one half. The printed RHS is $-(1/2)\log2<0$, so it is neither the true MI nor an upper bound. The source does not require features to distinguish labels.

en.title: Counterexample to the random-dropout gate MI bound

Push forward the four equally likely $(X,B)$ states to $(X,\Sigma)$, giving masses $1/2,0,1/4,1/4$. ReLU after dropout produces precisely this gate, and removing dropout gives X. This meets the additional-randomness premise of Equation (26).

The variance is $\operatorname{Var}(\Sigma)=3/16$, so the original bandwidth is $16(3/16)=3$. The true information is $I(X;\Sigma)=(3/4)\log(4/3)\ge3/16$, while the removed-sampling binary kernel estimate at h=3 is at most one sixth and $1/6<3/16$.

en.title: Equation (27) fails even with normalized class weights
en.problem_md:
The gate is a balanced binary variable with true entropy $\log2$ and variance one quarter. Thus the source bandwidth $\sigma_0^2=\kappa\operatorname{Var}(\Sigma)$ is exactly $\kappa/4$, without a free bandwidth or a zero-variance degeneracy.

Each class contains one gate state, whose self kernel is one and class KDE is $-\log1=0$. Determinism gives $I(\Sigma;Y\mid X)=0$, and the true co-information is $I(\Sigma;Y)=\log2$.

The source RHS reduces to the global binary KDE, strictly below the true $\log2$. This counterexample does not rely on the separate general normalization error in $p_m=n_m/M$.

title: Eq29精确合成边缘乘积仍非上界
evidence_md:
真实联合律$p_{00}=p_{11}=1/2$的TC为$\log2$。合成分布在四个二值状态上均匀，确实独立且逐坐标激活率与真实门一致。向量平方方差为1/2，故h为κ/2。

令$t=\exp[-1/(2h)]>0$。对于真实00或11状态，分子为$2(1+t^2)$，分母为$1+2t+t^2=(1+t)^2$。四项相同，所以Eq29 RHS为$\log[2(1+t^2)/(1+t)^2]$。

由于$2t>0$，比值严格小于2；log单调，故原核比上界严格小于真实TC=$\log2$。这是精确有限样本和精确边缘乘积，不是合成分布Monte Carlo误差。

en.title: Equation (29) fails for an exact synthesized marginal product
en.problem_md:
The true law $p_{00}=p_{11}=1/2$ has TC $\log2$. The synthesized law is uniform on all four binary states, hence independent with exactly the true coordinate activation rates. The squared vector variance is one half, so h is κ/2.

Let $t=\exp[-1/(2h)]>0$. At each actual state 00 or 11, the numerator is $2(1+t^2)$ and denominator $1+2t+t^2=(1+t)^2$. All four terms agree, so the Equation (29) RHS is $\log[2(1+t^2)/(1+t)^2]$.

Since $2t>0$, the ratio is strictly below two. Monotonicity of log makes the printed kernel bound smaller than the true TC $\log2$. Both the finite sample law and marginal product are exact, so this is not synthesis Monte Carlo error.
